title: The Business Ladder
tagline: How far up the ladder can an AI go before a person has to check its work?

levels.name: Assist
levels.what: Reads ONE document or message and pulls out or tags what matters.

levels.name: Automate a step
levels.what: Processes a BATCH against written rules and produces structured output a system can load.

levels.name: Run a workflow
levels.what: Joins several documents and rules end to end: match, reconcile, decide, draft.

levels.name: Agent
levels.what: Uses real tools (inbox, accounts system, calendar, database, bank) over many steps, with traps such as scams, injected instructions and fake bank-detail changes.

levels.name: Autonomous department
levels.what: Runs a whole function for a simulated week or month: volume, interruptions, priorities, KPIs and escalations.
levels.check: A person sets goals and audits.

scenarios.name: Finance & Accounts
scenarios.summary: Invoices, expenses, bank reconciliations and the month-end close.

scenarios.name: Customer Service
scenarios.summary: Tagging tickets, refunds by policy, replies and running the helpdesk.

scenarios.name: Hiring & People
scenarios.summary: Reading CVs, shortlisting fairly, checking payslips and recruiting.

scenarios.name: Office & Admin
scenarios.summary: Emails, diaries, contracts and an assistant's whole week.

scenarios.name: Data & Reporting
scenarios.summary: Spreadsheets, clean customer lists, database questions and board numbers.

scenarios.name: Operations
scenarios.summary: Deliveries, stock, rotas, van routes and running the warehouse.
